works.body:
Hello! I love your illustrations! Would you please draw my VTuber?

My VTuber character: https://twitter.com/KiliaKurayami/status/1678933278038827008/photo/1
Her name is Kilia Kurayami. She is an orca/sea creature. She is also cute and crazy. Her height is 153cm. She has a tail and dark gradient hands.

Pose: https://ibb.co/kSVNtMZ
Background: https://ibb.co/j5jGyL2
Outfit: https://ibb.co/Njz0YgS
Hairstyle: https://ibb.co/v1hph7C

Please experiment as much as you would like! Your artstyle is super cool, I would basically just love to see an eldritch version of my character!

I would like to use the art for SNS (YouTube/X) and will credit you. Please separate the character from the background in the .psd if possible! Don't cut off the head in the illustration. If possible, I would love it if the illustration dimensions were 16:9 (1920x1080 or higher).

Hi zapi, I'm a big fan of your style!
I'd like to request a drawing of Coni Confetti (@coni_confetti), a vtuber I'm a fan of, in a goth/punk outfit. I've included an example reference (1_goth_coni in the linked folder) of the sort of look I have in mind. 
Pose/Composition:
Something that shows off her bratty/teasing personality and sharp teeth
Usage:
I'd like for her to be able to use the art for schedules, YouTube thumbnails, or profile pictures if she wants.

Thank you for your time!

こんにちは! あなたのイラストすごくきれい！ このキャラクターを書いてもらえますか？

戸島 • 黄泉(とじま•よみ): https://sta.sh/2201lw3vftif
カルトから逃げた泣き虫の男性。傷だらけ。地雷男。
性格特性：自信がない。臆病。

自由に書いていいです。新しい服もかいていいです。ご検討のほどよろしくお願いいたします。楽しんで頂けたら嬉しいのです、 ありがとうございました！

Greetings to dear zapi,
I really appreciated the artwork from my last request!! The texture and atmosphere are both impressive. If this doesn't trouble you, I would like to make another request of my original character. 
This black-haired girl is rather self-centered and self-indulgent. She came from a broken family and then got pushed around by her relatives. She holds a strong feeling that she never received what other people are granted, which she has to patch up by fair means or foul. She only pretends to be vulnerable and indecisive, whereas in fact, she is indifferent to other people's sufferings since she's more interested in her own struggles. 
One detail to note is that she has these semicircular red eyeshadow at the end of her eyes. This is a key feature of hers. Please feel free to portray her as innocent or whatever you think would suit her.
A million thanks in advance!! Please take care in the meantime.

https://twitter.com/Fungi_Feast/status/1655345106000519168?s=20

Greetings to dear zapi,
The rich colors and complex atmosphere in your artwork captivated me at first sight, and I would like to invite you to draw my original character if that suits your interest. Her name is Rafaeya Aphelion. She used to be a famous child star under her mother's control and exploitation. Her mother, who had been her manager at the same time, forced her to wear mature clothes and makeup on the stage, then compelled her to work in times of illness. Her impression comes from Swan Lake and the film My Little Princess. She has a gentle yet sometimes delusional nature.
A million thanks for reading through my request, and please have my warmest regards!!

Nice to meet you!
My name is Colonel Shibaran, a reptilian Vliver, creator and distributor in Japan: ☺️

I would like to contact you to request an illustration!
I saw your illustrations on Instagram!
I especially like the dark atmosphere, the absorbing eyes, and the deep paint, and I was hoping to commission an illustration from you someday.
I would be very happy to work with you!
Here are the details: 🙇‍♀️

Pose, composition, etc.
1) Exhaustion (Colonel Shibaran's V body)
▶︎ Slightly sweaty and frightened expression
▶︎Frontal/waist up
▶︎ glad if there is a glasses difference
▶︎ atmosphere darker
No specification on ▶︎ pose/background

Desired size, data format, etc.
Size: 16:9 1920 x 1080 px or larger
Data format: png is preferred (background included/people only)

■Documents and references
▶︎ depleted: https://twitter.com/shibaran_taisa/status/1612408676408791041?s=46&t=adTI6wSlK0Ycnj2_nTtrEA
A girl who lives in virtual Japan, she is an energetic, but also mature, chin-tailed bearded lizard.
She is 162 cm tall, thin but muscular.
Her image color is purple.
Her charm points are the mole on the lower left side of her mouth, her lizard tail, and her purple inner color.

Usage
(1) Icons/headers for Twitter, discord, etc.
(2) Thumbnails for distribution (I often play hora-games in particular/I will refrain from using them if they are not allowed to be used in monetized distribution.
